about_the_game:
Cleanse the system of pirate presence, destroy their bases and free everyone who fell into their hands.

On the asteroids, build your first generators, start refineries, explore asteroids and extract resources necessary for survival.
Over time, you will develop industry, unlock new types of ships and weapon systems, rescue survivors from the pirates’ hands and transform a lonely rock into a fortress.

Gameplay Features

  • Procedurally generated system
    Each playthrough is a new layout of asteroids, resource points and enemy stations arranged differently each time.

  • Base construction and development
    Build habitats, ports, power plants, refineries and defense towers. Upgrades unlock new productions and ship types.

  • Mining and processing
    Explore asteroids, mine deposits manually, with mining ships or build automated mines.

  • Mining colonies
    Develop the infrastructure of mines, ports and transport networks to efficiently move resources between colonies.

  • Space exploration
    Locate wrecks, rescue survivors from pirate ships, intercept convoys and destroy pirate bases in distant sectors.

  • Base defense
    Plan the layout of buildings in terms of energy and firing fields. Pirate raids escalate over time, and every gap in the system can be fatal.

  • Ship combat
    From light fighters to heavy frigates – dynamic battles in space using lasers and rockets.

Gameplay atmosphere

A light space survival focused on free play, base building and dynamic space battles.
Explore, develop and fight – step by step regain control over the system that pirates have claimed as their own.

The project is constantly being developed — bugs or technical issues may occur and will be fixed in future updates.
Thank you for reporting feedback and for your support!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 3.6 GHz Quad Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 or Radeon
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
